example.content:
let tickCount = 0;
const created = eda.sys_Timer.setIntervalTimer('嘉立创示例_停表', 200, () => { tickCount++; });

await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
const ticksAtClear = tickCount;

const cleared = eda.sys_Timer.clearIntervalTimer('嘉立创示例_停表');
await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 600));

_source.title: 清除指定循环定时器
_source.example.text.0: 1. 挂一个每 200ms 触发的循环定时器
_source.example.text.2: 3. 清除定时器，回调不再触发
_source.example.text.3: 4. 清除不存在的 ID 返回 false（该定时器已在上一步被清除）

title: Clear the specified interval timer
returns: Whether the timer was cleared successfully
